mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window or average 20-day returns during FEDFUNDS < 0.5% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points (UNRATE > prior month + 0.5pp) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending confidence and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 5-day S&P 500 returns following UNRATE > prior + 0.5pp increases are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC for UNRATE as a 5-day predictor is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST < 500k units) and consumer spending (RSAFS < 350k million dollars) indicate broad-based demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST*RSAFS interaction term as a 60-day predictor is below 0.03 or average 60-day returns during joint HOUST/RSAFS declines are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% y/y), the Federal Reserve is compelled to tighten policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day returns during CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (y/y) periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in high inflation regimes is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS > 130k) signals improving labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS as a 5-day predictor falls below 0.03 or average 5-day returns during PAYEMS > 130k periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production decline exceeding 0.5 percentage points (INDPRO < prior month - 0.5pp) indicates manufacturing sector contraction, reducing corporate output expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 60-day S&P 500 returns following INDPRO > 0.5pp declines are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC for INDPRO as a 60-day predictor is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST < 500k) and consumer spending (RSAFS < 350k) relative to 12-month averages signal a demand shock, reducing corporate revenue forecasts and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST*RSAFS interaction term as a 20-day predictor is below 0.03 or average 20-day returns during joint HOUST/RSAFS below-12mo-average periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During recessionary regimes (GDPC1 growth < 0.0% and INDPRO decline > 0.5pp), a sharp industrial production contraction (INDPRO < prior month - 0.5pp) signals worsening supply chain disruptions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 0.0% AND INDPRO decline > 0.5pp (from prior month)
failure_condition: Average 5-day returns during recessionary regimes with INDPRO declines > 0.5pp are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC for INDPRO in recessionary regimes is below 0.03.
